remarks: Let's extend SUMMER! Step into your ultimate rental oasis tucked away in a serene cul-de-sac, boasting over 3100sf of luxury living. This meticulously cared-for property boasts 4 bdrms/3 full bths, ensuring every inch is dedicated to relaxation & enjoyment. Be swept away by the majestic views of Signal Lake from your sprawling multi-level deck, setting the scene for endless adventures in kayaking, canoeing, paddleboarding. Lose yourself in the tranquility of the surroundings, all while being just a stone's throw away from the sandy shores of Compo Beach & a mere 3-minutes to Westport Train. There's more! The heart of this haven lies in its extraordinary chef's kitchen. Entertain guests in style as the open layout seamlessly connects the kitchen to the living spaces. As the temp. drops, cozy up by the newly appointed fireplace, a perfect spot to watch the vibrant autumn hues unfold. Explore all that Westport has to offer-from the sun-kissed shores of Compo Beach to the vibrant pulse of Main Street's charming shops & delectable dining options. Easy access to Longshore Club, Levitt Pavilion, Sherwood Island & Burying Hill beaches, the adventures are endless. Don't let this opportunity slip away! Experience the ultimate autumn escape, where nature's beauty harmonizes w/ the comforts of home. Whether it's lounging on the dock w/ a good book, savoring sunsets at Compo Beach or embarking on a paddle boarding expedition down the river, this home is your ticket to retreat and relax!
